d:
For Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the incumbent president of Brazil, political comebacks are business as usual. The 80-year-old staged another stunning comeback Monday, defying projections and political obituaries to defeat Flávio Bolsonaro, the 45-year-old senator and son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, to secure an unprecedented fourth presidential term. No other candidate in Brazilian presidential elections has ever won a runoff after losing the first round.
Debdutta Chakraborty explains how Lula pulled it off and what it means for India.
